text: The old steam ferry-boat was chartered for the occasion; presently the gay throng filed up the main street laden with provision-baskets. Sid was sick and had to miss the fun; Mary remained at home to entertain him. The last thing Mrs. Thatcher said to Becky, was: “You’ll not get back till late. Perhaps you’d better stay all night with some of the girls that live near the ferry-landing, child.” “Then I’ll stay with Susy Harper, mamma.” “Very well. And mind and behave yourself and don’t be any trouble.” Presently, as they tripped along, Tom said to Becky: “Say—I’ll tell you what we’ll do.
